rows.text: OBJECTIVE ITEM: Roll again if the captain is at a space port, otherwise an Objective Item has been found that may be required for the current mission (check the away mission’s details). If it’s not needed, it is in- stead an ancient alien artefact (AAA) worth 100c. 100c
(XL) ACUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +4 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon. 140c
(XL) BRUTE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to gain +4 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon. 140c
(XL) SPEED ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +4 Def against enemy’s next damage roll. 200c
(XL) ARMOUR UPGRADE: Roll on table A – Armour and add “(XL)” before its name. It gains +0.6 Def and gains +300 credit to its value and 60 credits to its fix cost. +300c/+60c
(XL) ACID WRAP: Use to deduct -5 pips from the acid track. 200c
(XL) MED PACK: Use to replenish up to 10 lost HP. 200c
(XL) BRAIN ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +20 Int to next test. 300c
(XL) MIGHT ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +20 Str to next test. 300c
(XL) NIMBLE ENHANCER DRINK: Use to add +20 Dex to next test. 300c
(XL) CLEANSING WRAP: Use to deduct -5 pips from the plague track. 325c
CYBERCON™ PATCH: Roll on table I – Implants +10 for the patch that is found. Add “Patch” after its name when you add it to the log sheet. 200c
(XL) KARMA TONIC: Use to add +20 to a result when rolling on the next table. 400c
(XL) ENDURING KARMA TONIC: Use to gain 3 karma point. 400c
(XL) BRAIN BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +20 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track. 600c
(XL) MIGHT BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +20 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track. 600c
(XL) NIMBLE BOOSTER CAPSULE: Use to gain +20 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track. 600c
(XL) ENDURING DEX TONIC: Use to gain 3 point of primary Dex. 900c
(XL) ENDURING IN TONIC: Use to gain 3 point of primary Int. 900c
(XL) ENDURING STR TONIC: Use to gain 3 point of primary Str. 900c
(XL) ENDURING HEALTH TONIC: Use to gain 3 point of primary HP. 1200c
(XL) WEAPON UPGRADE: Roll on table W – Weapon and add “(XL)” before its name. Add +4 to its Dmg value. It gains +1200 credit to its value. +1200c
CYBERCON™ IMPLANT: Roll on table I – Implants +10 for the implant that is found. 800c
(XL) ENDURING LIFE TONIC: Use to gain 3 Life point. 3000c
EXTRA TRAPPINGS: Roll on each of the following tables once, TA - Trappings A -3,  TB - Trappings B -3, and TC - Trappings C -3. -
POWERED ARMOUR: Powered armour has been found. Roll on table A – Armour +10 for the armour and then on table P - Powers +10 for its power and adjust its value. -
POWERED WEAPON: A powered weapon has been found. Roll on table W – Weapons +10 for the weapon and then on table P - Powers +10 for its power and adjust its value. -
